remedy_text: Boil 5-6 fresh Tulsi leaves and 1/2 tsp Mulethi (Licorice) powder in 2 cups of water until reduced to 1 cup. Strain and drink warm twice daily. Perform warm water gargles with a pinch of rock salt.
ayurvedic_note: Pacifies Kapha and Vata doshas, soothes mucosal lining.

dosage.adult: 40-80 ml lukewarm kwath twice daily, 30 min after meals
dosage.child_6_12: 20-40 ml lukewarm kwath once daily after meals
dosage.child_under_6: Not recommended for children under 6 without physician guidance
dosage.elderly: 30-40 ml lukewarm kwath twice daily after meals
dosage.hindi: Din mein 1-2 baar khana khane ke 30 minute baad gunguna piyein

remedy_text: Boil 1/2 tsp Cumin (Jeera) and 1/2 tsp Carom seeds (Ajwain) with a pinch of black salt in 250ml water for 5 minutes. Sip slowly after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Kindles Deepana (digestive fire) and relieves Vata entrapment.

dosage.adult: 100-150 ml warm infusion sipped slowly after major meals
dosage.child_6_12: 50 ml warm infusion once daily after lunch
dosage.hindi: Khana khane ke baad din mein 1-2 baar gunguna ghunt-ghunt piyein

remedy_text: Mix 1/4 tsp pure turmeric powder and 1/2 tsp Ashwagandha root powder in 1 cup of warm milk. Consume before sleep.

dosage.adult: 1 cup (150-200 ml) warm ksheerapaka at bedtime
dosage.child_6_12: Half cup (80-100 ml) with half dosage of herbs at bedtime
dosage.child_under_6: Plain warm turmeric milk only, avoid Ashwagandha under 6
dosage.elderly: Half cup (100 ml) warm ksheerapaka before sleeping
dosage.hindi: Raat ko sone se pehle 1 cup gungune doodh ke sath lein

remedy_text: Mix 1 tsp fresh Vasa (Adhatoda vasica) leaf juice with 1 tsp raw organic honey. Take twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Potent bronchodilator and mucolytic herb native to Himalayan foothills.

dosage.adult: 1 teaspoon (5 ml) juice with 1 tsp honey, twice daily after food
dosage.child_6_12: Half teaspoon (2.5 ml) with 1 tsp honey, once daily
dosage.child_under_6: Avoid Vasa in children under 6; consult doctor
dosage.elderly: Half teaspoon twice daily with honey
dosage.hindi: Din mein 1-2 baar khana khane ke baad shahad ke sath lein

remedy_text: Boil 2 gm dry ginger rhizome in water, reduce to one-fourth, and drink 10–20 ml twice daily. Ginger paste can also be applied on forehead for headache.
ayurvedic_note: Stimulates Agni (digestive fire), relieves Kapha-related congestion.

dosage.adult: 10-20 ml warm decoction twice daily before or after food
dosage.child_6_12: 5-10 ml with a little honey once daily
dosage.child_under_6: Not recommended for infants; mild ginger water for ages 3-6
dosage.elderly: 10 ml warm decoction once or twice daily
dosage.hindi: Din mein 1-2 baar 10-20 ml gunguna piyein

remedy_text: Take 1 gm Ajwain powder with black salt in buttermilk twice daily. For sinusitis, apply warm paste over forehead and inhale vapors.
ayurvedic_note: Relieves Vata imbalance, useful in digestive and respiratory complaints.

dosage.adult: 1 gm powder with a glass of spiced buttermilk twice daily with meals
dosage.child_6_12: 0.5 gm in half glass buttermilk with lunch
dosage.elderly: 0.5-1 gm in warm buttermilk once daily
dosage.hindi: Dopehar ke khane ke sath chhaachh mein milakar lein

remedy_text: Consume 10–20 ml Amla juice daily. Apply paste of fruit rind on scalp to prevent hair fall and greying. Also useful for diabetes when combined with turmeric juice.
ayurvedic_note: Rasayana (rejuvenator), balances all three doshas, especially Pitta.

dosage.adult: 10-20 ml fresh juice mixed with equal water every morning on empty stomach
dosage.child_6_12: 5-10 ml diluted juice in the morning
dosage.elderly: 10 ml diluted juice in the morning
dosage.hindi: Subah khali pet 10-20 ml taaze paani ke sath lein

remedy_text: Boil handful of Tulsi leaves with 5 gm coriander seeds in water, reduce, and take 30 ml thrice daily for fever. Tulsi juice with honey relieves cough and cold.
ayurvedic_note: Sacred herb, balances Kapha and Vata, boosts immunity.

dosage.adult: 30 ml lukewarm decoction thrice daily during acute fever/cough
dosage.child_under_6: 5 ml with honey twice daily under supervision
dosage.hindi: Din mein 2-3 baar gunguna karke 30 ml piyein

remedy_text: Dissolve 1/2 tsp pure Haldi (Turmeric) powder and a small pinch of Sendha Namak (Rock salt) in 1 glass of warm water. Gargle deeply for 2-3 minutes, twice or thrice daily. This formula is completely safe for hypertension and high blood pressure patients as it contains no licorice (Mulethi).
ayurvedic_note: Haridra has potent anti-inflammatory (Shothahara) and antimicrobial (Krimighna) properties. Soothes pharyngeal mucosa without elevating blood pressure.

dosage.adult: Warm gargle with 1 glass water twice or thrice daily, do not swallow in excess
dosage.child_6_12: Warm gargle with half glass under parental supervision twice daily
dosage.child_under_6: Not recommended for children under 6 who cannot reliably gargle
dosage.hindi: Gungune paani mein haldi aur thoda sendha namak milakar din mein 2-3 baar garare karein

remedy_text: Coarsely crush 1 tsp Coriander seeds (Dhaniya) and 1 tsp Fennel seeds (Saunf). Soak in 1 cup (200 ml) of boiled and cooled room-temperature water for 4-6 hours or overnight. Strain and sip slowly on an empty stomach with a pinch of Mishri. Completely safe for peptic ulcer and gastric irritation as it contains no ginger, black pepper, or spicy carminatives.
ayurvedic_note: Dhanyaka and Mishreya pacify aggravated Pitta dosha, neutralize excess gastric acid (Amlata), and heal delicate mucous membranes in peptic ulcer.

dosage.adult: 1 cup (150-200 ml) cold infusion twice daily before meals
dosage.child_6_12: Half cup (80-100 ml) twice daily before food
dosage.hindi: Dhaniya aur saunf ko paani mein bhigo kar chhaan lein aur mishri ke sath subah-shaam piyein

remedy_text: Take 1 glass of fresh, diluted buttermilk (Takra). Add 1/2 tsp roasted Cumin powder (Bhuna Jeera), a pinch of dried Pomegranate seed powder (Anardana), and a pinch of rock salt. Drink twice daily after meals to restore gut flora and control loose stools.
ayurvedic_note: Takra with Jeera is Deepana and Grahani-hara; absorbs excess fluid from intestines and kindles digestive Agni.

dosage.adult: 1 glass (150-200 ml) spiced buttermilk twice daily after light khichdi
dosage.child_under_6: Plain boiled rice water or ORS; buttermilk only for ages 3+
dosage.elderly: Half to 1 glass fresh buttermilk twice daily
dosage.hindi: Dopehar aur shaam khane ke baad bhuna jeera aur anardana dali hui taazi chhaachh piyein

remedy_text: Soak 1 tsp Fenugreek seeds (Methi) in a cup of water overnight. In the morning, chew the seeds and drink the water. Warm 2 tbsp pure Sesame (Til) oil and gently massage the affected joints in circular motions, followed by warm towel fermentation.
ayurvedic_note: Methi pacifies Vata dosha, reduces synovial stiffness, while Til oil penetrates deeply to nourish Asthi-Sandhi (bones & joints).

dosage.adult: 1 tsp soaked methi with water in morning; warm oil massage twice daily
dosage.child_6_12: Gentle oil massage only, no internal methi needed
dosage.elderly: 1/2 tsp soaked methi + warm sesame oil massage twice daily
dosage.hindi: Raat ko bhigoyi methi subah chabayein aur til ke gungune tel se jodon ki malish karein

remedy_text: Boil 8-10 seeded large raisins (Munakka) in 1 glass of milk for 5 minutes. Drink warm at bedtime and chew the raisins. Alternatively, non-pregnant adults can take 1/2 tsp Triphala churna with warm water at night. (Note: For pregnant women, use Munakka milk only; avoid Triphala during pregnancy).
ayurvedic_note: Munakka is Snigdha and Mridu Rechana (mild natural laxative) that softens Apana Vata without causing griping or abdominal spasms.

dosage.adult: 1 glass warm munakka milk or 1/2 tsp triphala powder with warm water at bedtime
dosage.child_6_12: Half glass warm munakka milk with 4-5 munakka at bedtime
dosage.child_under_6: Soaked munakka water 2-3 tsp for toddlers
dosage.elderly: 1 glass warm munakka milk before sleep
dosage.hindi: Raat ko sone se pehle munakka ubla hua gunguna doodh piyein

remedy_text: Crush 1 green Cardamom pod (Elaichi) and gently suck on the seeds. Alternatively, mix 1 tsp fresh Lemon juice, 1 tsp Mint (Pudina) juice, and a pinch of Mishri in half cup water, and take small sips. Completely safe during pregnancy and for patients with acid peptic disorders.
ayurvedic_note: Elaichi (Sukshmaila) and Pudina are Tridoshashamaka, pacify Udana Vata, and soothe irritated stomach nerves (Hrillasa-hara).

dosage.adult: 1 elaichi pod chewed slowly, or 50 ml mint-lemon water sipped slowly during nausea
dosage.child_6_12: Half elaichi or 25 ml mint-lemon water in sips
dosage.child_under_6: Few drops of mint water with a pinch of mishri
dosage.elderly: 1 elaichi chewed slowly or warm mint water
dosage.hindi: Chhoti elaichi ke daane chabayein ya nimbu-pudina paani ghunt-ghunt piyein

condition_name: Minor Skin Rash & Insect Bites (Kandu / Twak Roga)
remedy_text: Boil a handful of fresh Neem leaves in 1 litre water for 10 minutes, let it cool, and wash the affected skin area. Apply a soothing paste of fresh Aloe vera gel mixed with a pinch of pure Turmeric (Haldi) powder over the rash twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Nimba and Haridra possess powerful Tikta-Kashaya rasas, detoxify Pitta and Rakta dhatus, and instantly alleviate itching (Kandughna).

dosage.adult: Wash affected skin with neem water twice daily and apply aloe-turmeric paste
dosage.child_6_12: Gentle wash with lukewarm neem water and fresh aloe gel
dosage.child_under_6: External plain aloe vera gel only, test small patch first
dosage.elderly: External wash and aloe-turmeric paste twice daily
dosage.hindi: Neem ke paani se dhowein aur aloe vera tatha haldi ka lep lagayein

remedy_text: Boil 1/2 tsp Carom seeds (Ajwain) and 1 tsp crushed organic Jaggery (Guda) in 1 glass of water until reduced to half. Strain and drink warm twice daily during painful menstrual cycle days. (Contraindicated in pregnancy).
ayurvedic_note: Ajwain combined with Guda acts as an Antispasmodic and Vata-Anulomaka, soothing uterine muscle spasms and promoting easy Apana flow.

dosage.adult: Half cup (100 ml) warm decoction twice daily during cramp days
dosage.hindi: Gungune paani mein ajwain aur gud ubaal kar din mein 1-2 baar piyein
